QuestInfo.name: Chance for a Counter Attack
QuestInfo.0: Doctor Bing says that he has some big news.\r\nGo see Doctor Bing in his laboratory.
QuestInfo.1: You received information about the Mothership's crash from Doctor Bing.\r\nFind Doctor Bing's forces and head over to the Mothership crash site.
QuestInfo.2: You received information from Wynn, who was analyzing the Mothership at the crash site.

0.0: You're here! One of the motherships have finally crashed!\r\n#L0##bHave you gone inside yet?#l\n#k
0.1: Not yet. My troops are guarding it now. Wynn is on site analyzing the mothership.\r\n#L0##bI would like to go inside.#l\n#k
0.2: Very well. Search for my troops. They'll lead you to Wynn at the crash site.

yes.0: Wynn can tell you the analysis results, too. I'll see you there.

no.0: You know, there are others who want to venture into the mothership, too. You should be grateful for the opportunity...

1.0: Isn't it amazing?! It's odd, though, that the mothership crashed at such a convenient time for us. Almost feels...intentional.\r\n#L0##bHave you examined the interior of the ship yet?#l\n#k
1.1: Not completely. We know that the inside is constructed of large Cubes. How they work...is anyone's guess.\r\n#L0##bI should enter and investigate.#l\n#k
1.2: We do know this. The Cubes in the ship are connected by portals.\r\n#L0##bThey're even connected to those ships in the sky?#l\n#k
1.3: We should be able to use this knowledge to our advantage.\r\nBut first, accept the 5th official mission issued by the OSSS.

yes.0: Okay, talk to me again so that I can give you the mission. But, if your level isn't #bat least Lv.30#k, I won't say anything for your safety.
